profile.hook: B2C Product Manager who transitioned into the B2B space.
profile.summary: The profile clearly reflects the transition from a technical, consumer-focused background (Data Science, ML, and B2C projects like Snapdeal VIP) into high-level B2B Product Management (IBM Sterling Order Management). His work consistently emphasizes UX-first thinking applied to complex organizational efficiency problems.

projects.title: SigmaZK - Proof of Work in a Zero Knowledge Way
projects.description: Implemented a ZeroKnowledge-based system with collab.land and Polygon ID. Improved the Polygon ID API by working around one of its major limitations (allowing only one issuer per organization). Award: Winner, Best use of Polygon ID at ETHIndia 2022.

projects.title: Data Analysis on Air Pollution Statistics Pre-Covid and Post-Covid
projects.description: Data analytics on KPIs including air quality variations across cities and identifying cities with severe conditions. Award: Winner, Data Day Grind III by MLH.

projects.title: NotebookLM for Windows
projects.description: Developed a native Windows wrapper for NotebookLM that keeps sessions alive and launches fast, treating it as a product that needed friction-point resolution.

volunteering.title: Volunteer – Safe Odisha For Her
volunteering.description: Contributed to a fundraising strategy for Baula Fellows to establish micro-enterprises, combining gender empowerment and entrepreneurial development. Created professional pitch decks and curated funder lists.

recommendations.name: Adamya Singh
recommendations.designation: Product Management Intern Team Lead, IBM
recommendations.text: It is my pleasure to recommend Gyanesh for his outstanding contributions as an intern on the IBM Sterling Order Management Product Management team. During his two-month tenure, Gyanesh quickly distinguished himself as a proactive, responsive, and high-impact contributor. His ability to rapidly grasp complex concepts, identify opportunities to add value, and deliver high-quality solutions was remarkable. Gyanesh took ownership of in-depth competitive analyses for strategic deals, providing actionable insights that strengthened our go-to-market strategy. He also collaborated cross-functionally to streamline over 1,200 business-critical RFP questions, showcasing his strong research skills and ability to drive efficiency...

recommendations.name: Shreya Gupta
recommendations.text: Gyanesh possesses exceptional data and backend skills that truly set him apart. His ability to navigate complex data structures and backend systems with ease is commendable... He approaches every task with enthusiasm and a positive mindset, making him a valuable addition to any team... his excellent communication skills have been instrumental in facilitating effective collaboration.

recommendations.name: Kamaldeep Singh
recommendations.designation: Senior Manager Advanced Analytics at Walmart Marketplace
recommendations.text: He played a crucial role in managing our AWS infrastructure, making sure everything ran smoothly. His work on our RDS databases and ETL pipelines was top-notch... He dove into complex tasks like crafting queries in subgraphs and conducting in-depth analytics using Dune... what really impressed me was how he seamlessly transitioned into a role focused on data and product.

recommendations.name: Shakir Wani
recommendations.designation: Head - Data Science for TCNS ABFRL
recommendations.text: Gyanesh has sound knowledge of ML and is a great asset to any team, having mentored him for last 1 year it has been a great pleasure to work with him.
